title: Stop tests fail under full-suite load in a lane worktree and pass alone
body:
Full npm test in a lane worktree (2026-11-17, branch lane-start-slim, 4 lanes running) failed 6 test/hook/stop.test.ts cases (krn-lane subagent judged at main checkout; merged lane stops without verdict; missing test root named by directory; worktree gone + branch merged; released claim accepts lane branch; worker Stop gate judges claimed worktree); the same file passes 87/87 alone in the same worktree and on main. Logs: .krn/tmp/stop-slim.log, task output b7wa9td4u. A load- or ambient-env-dependent Stop test blocks every lane ship's Proof.
Files: test/hook/stop.test.ts, scripts/test-suite.mjs
Outcome: the six cases pass in 5 consecutive full npm test runs under 3 concurrent lane loads, or the shared state they race on is isolated; the root cause is named in the PR.
Proof: five consecutive npm test runs with KRN_TEST_SHARDS default show 0 failures in test/hook/stop.test.ts.
